title: Source manifest
description: Metadata and citation identity for one raw source. The manifest is versioned in Git because our reading of a source improves; the bytes it points at are immutable. Enforcing implementation is checks/kb.py.

id.description: Stable citation identity, matching the filename. Wiki pages cite this, never a hash.

status.description: active means the bytes are captured and hashed; reference-only means we have pointed at it but not stored it, which caps citing pages below high confidence.

raw_uri.description: Location in the content-addressed raw store. Required when status is active.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes. Required when status is active. Verified against the stored object whenever the raw store is reachable; a mismatch means the create-only store was mutated.

notes.description: One line. The YAML subset has no multi-line strings.

x-immutability.description: Raw objects are create-only. Enforced by REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE plus a trigger in db/schema.sql, not by instructions to agents. Content-addressing makes the invariant auditable.
